##### Project general facts

The Gate 5 by Arada is a sleek contemporary residential building that celebrates light and open living. The building rises above a basement level, a ground floor and a podium to eight residential floors, with a modern facade and generous glazing that fill the interiors with daylight. The collection offers one-bedroom apartments and generous two- and three-bedroom family homes, with selected residences featuring winter gardens that extend the living space towards the balcony and blur the line between indoors and out.

A swimming pool, a fully equipped gym and a running track support a healthy routine at home. The flagship sports complex of the community sits alongside the building, with football fields, basketball and volleyball courts, badminton areas and padel tennis courts for active recreation. Green parks, meandering walking routes and dedicated leisure zones offer calm settings for relaxation, while boutiques and eateries are a short stroll away along the lively boulevard.

Every residence features intelligent home systems and premium European kitchen appliances, combining comfort with efficiency. Kitchens are fitted with a premium European cooking range, an extractor hood and a washer-dryer, while modern finishes and high-quality materials create an elegant, practical backdrop for everyday life. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens and appliances, leaving furniture and decor entirely to the owner's own taste and making every apartment easy to personalise.

##### Location description and benefits

Aljada is a large master-planned community in Sharjah whose layout draws inspiration from the historic districts of the emirate, blending heritage character with contemporary design. Its heart is Madar, a family entertainment destination designed by Zaha Hadid Architects, with the Zad food truck park, a drive-in cinema, a large skate park, a gym and a trampoline centre, while the lively West Boulevard and the community sports park sit within walking distance of the building.

Emirates Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and University City Road connect the community with the rest of Sharjah, Dubai and the northern emirates. Madar and City Centre Al Zahia are a short drive away, University City and Sharjah International Airport are close by, and Dubai International Airport and Downtown Dubai are within comfortable driving distance for daily commuters and frequent travellers.

Aljada is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the largest mixed-use destinations in Sharjah. Integrated schools, hotels, parks, a business district and extensive sports and leisure facilities attract families, students and young professionals alike. Accessible entry prices compared with Dubai and steady tenant demand support attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners and investors.
